what_is_built: image_gen_router.py (37KB) — unified image gen router with OpenAI + OpenRouter
krea_mcp.py (19KB) — Krea AI MCP client (32 tools, 90 models)
image_dissector.py (23KB) — visual DNA extraction (palette, composition, OCR, recipe)
brand_dna.py (19KB) — BrandContext loader + prompt + negative builder
visual_dna_query.py (17KB) — search/tag/find similar across the library
product_service_library.py (20KB) — products + services with prompt fragments
what_actually_works: Krea image gen works end-to-end (live test 2026-08-31: bfl/flux-1.1-pro → 1024×1024 PNG, 7.5s)
Krea model registry: 90 models cached across 4 categories (image/video/enhance/3d)
Krea prompt-guide + schema caching works (90 guides cached)
Brand-directory index returns all 3 brands (swing-shack, stick, bag-drop)
Brand DNA system returns palette + archetypes for all brands
Visual library stats: swing-shack has 122 images indexed
Product library: 9 products for swing-shack (TrackMan, Takomo 101T, etc.)
Intel/brand-context endpoint returns positioning + tone + assets
what_is_broken_or_weak: P0 — OpenRouter credits exhausted (7,198 remaining). Default route /api/image/generate fails with 402 Payment Required. Image gen currently cannot run via the unified router.

P0 — Brand bibles are placeholders. swing-shack/bible-visual.json has TODO keywords + explicit `_todos_for_christelle` for Christelle to fill in. stick/takomo/bag-drop don't have bible-visual.json at all. Generation has no canonical creative direction for these brands.
P0 — Stick has no visual-dna-index. brand_dna reports 'visual-dna-index.json missing — no visual reference anchors'. Reference DNA flow has nothing to point at for stick.
P1 — Krea token doesn't survive Railway deploys. Every time Railway restarts the env, `connected: false` until secret-drop is called again. Permanent storage solution missing.
P1 — /api/krea/knowledge endpoints require scripts/ in deploy path (fixed in Dockerfile, but cron/refresh requires on-disk scripts access)
P1 — No AUTO model router. Krea has 90 models; the user must pick one explicitly. The user's directive #4 specifically asks for this.
P1 — No product-fidelity preservation logic. The existing image_gen_router has `_detect_logo_preserve_drift(instruction)` but no PRESERVE block builder.
P1 — No deterministic post-composition. AI models hallucinate logos + typography. The system has no way to overlay the real logo + brand fonts on top of AI output.
P2 — No reference-led 'make me another one like this' pipeline that ties reference DNA → product preservation → auto brand rules. The user directive specifically asks for this.
P2 — No creative lineage from asset → campaign → performance. /api/image/outputs/<brand> returns 0 outputs; lineage broken.
P2 — No creative feedback / approval / rejection tagging. The 'feedback_loop.py' module exists but has 0 records; never populated.
P2 — No negative-prompt constraint engine specific to golf equipment (bent shaft, wrong club geometry, etc.). The current `build_negative_prompt` is generic.
P3 — No daily web-research cron for Krea prompt best-practices. /api/krea/knowledge/research queues queries but doesn't execute them.
P3 — The 'prompt preview' button in image-lab calls a UI-only preview; not saved with the generated output.
